senses.title: A systematic scientific explanation
senses.titleCN: 科学理论：能解释事实的体系
senses.definition: a well-tested and widely accepted explanation of natural phenomena, supported by evidence
senses.definitionCN: 经充分检验、被广泛接受且有证据支持的自然现象解释
senses.example: The theory of plate tectonics explains why continents move.
senses.exampleCN: 板块构造理论解释了大陆为何移动。
senses.why: Greek theōria was a viewing, a act of watching. A scientific theory begins with careful observation, then builds the explanation that the watching supports.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 theōria 是“观看、观察”。科学理论从仔细观看开始，再建立观看所支持的说明。

senses.title: A body of ideas or doctrine
senses.titleCN: 学说：一个学派的一整套看法
senses.definition: a organized set of ideas or beliefs about a subject, often associated with a school or thinker
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题的有组织的一套观念或信念，常与某个学派或思想家相关
senses.example: He studied Marx's theory of history for his dissertation.
senses.exampleCN: 他为博士论文研究了马克思的历史学说。
senses.why: A single observation grows into a connected body of claims. The word then names the whole doctrine, not one explanation of one fact.
senses.whyCN: 单次观察长成一套相互关联的主张。这个词于是指整套学说，而不是对单一事实的解释。

senses.title: The principles behind a practice
senses.titleCN: 原理：一门技艺背后的道理
senses.definition: the general principles or rules underlying a practical art or skill
senses.definitionCN: 某一实践技艺背后的一般原理或规则
senses.example: She studied the theory of music before touching the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她在碰钢琴之前先学了乐理。
senses.why: Watching a practice from above yields its rules. Theory here is the map of a craft, separated from the hand that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 从高处观看一门实践，就得到它的规则。这里的 theory 是一门手艺的地图，与实际操作的双手分离。

senses.title: A hypothesis offered as explanation
senses.definition: a proposed explanation that has not yet been proven or fully tested
senses.definitionCN: 尚未被证实或充分检验的提议性解释
senses.example: His theory is that the ship sank in a sudden storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他的假设是那艘船在突发的风暴中沉没。
senses.why: The same explanatory frame can be built before the evidence arrives. Then it is a hypothesis, but English still calls it a theory.
senses.whyCN: 同样的解释框架可以在证据到来之前先搭起来。这时它是假设，但英语仍称之为 theory。

senses.title: A speculative opinion
senses.definition: an opinion or conjecture based on limited evidence, often in everyday talk
senses.definitionCN: 基于有限证据的看法或猜想，常用于日常谈话
senses.example: My theory is that the cat knocked the vase off the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我的推测是猫把花瓶从架子上碰了下来。
senses.why: In ordinary speech, watching becomes guessing. The word loses its scientific weight and names any attempt to explain what happened.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，观看变成了猜测。这个词失去科学分量，可以指任何对事情经过的解释尝试。

senses.title: In theory: as reasoned, not as practised
senses.titleCN: 理论上：推算成立，现实未必
senses.definition: used in the phrase in theory to mean according to reasoning or principle, as opposed to actual practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in theory，表示按推理或原理应当如此，与实际做法相对
senses.example: In theory, the system can process a million requests a second.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上，这个系统每秒能处理一百万次请求。
senses.why: Theory is what the spectator sees from the stand; practice is what happens on the field. The phrase sets the two viewpoints against each other.
senses.whyCN: theory 是看台上观众看到的，practice 是球场上实际发生的。这个短语把两个视角摆在对立面。

senses.title: Book learning as opposed to practice
senses.titleCN: 理论课：书本上的那一半
senses.definition: the part of a subject taught as principles and books rather than as hands-on practice
senses.definitionCN: 以原理和书本而非动手实践来教授的那部分内容
senses.example: The course balances theory with six hours of lab work.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把理论课与六小时实验课相平衡。
senses.why: In training, the viewing half and the doing half are separated. Theory class is where you watch and read before you are allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 在培训中，“观看”的一半和“动手”的一半被分开。理论课就是你被允许动手之前观看与阅读的地方。

senses.title: Idle or unrealistic speculation
senses.definition: speculation that is impractical or disconnected from reality, often used with a critical tone
senses.definitionCN: 不切实际或脱离现实的推测，常带批评语气
senses.example: That is pure theory; no one has tried it on a real farm.
senses.exampleCN: 那纯粹是纸上谈兵；没人在真实农场里试过。
senses.why: When the stand is too far from the field, watching never turns into doing. The word then carries the old complaint against pure contemplation.
senses.whyCN: 当看台离球场太远，观看就永远变不成行动。这个词于是带上了对纯粹空想的古老抱怨。

intro.en: Theory comes from Greek theōria 'a looking at, contemplation', built on thea 'a view' and the spectator word theōros. Latin and French carried it to English, where it shifted from watching to explaining.
intro.cn: theory 来自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与“观看者”theōros 构成。经拉丁语与法语进入英语，语义从“观看”转向“解释”。

items.en: Thea meant a view or a sight, the thing seen. It survives in English words such as theatre, where the view is what the audience comes for.
items.cn: thea 意为景象、所见之物。它保留在 theatre 等英语词中——观众来剧院，正是为了那个“景象”。

items.en: Theōros was a spectator, and also an envoy sent to consult an oracle or to watch a sacred festival. Watching was a public and often official act.
items.cn: theōros 是观看者，也是被派去求神谕或观看宗教节庆的使者。观看是一种公共的、常常带官方性质的行动。

items.en: Theōria meant a looking at, contemplation, and later a body of speculative knowledge. Philosophy used it for the highest kind of seeing.
items.cn: theōria 意为观看、沉思，后来指思辨性的知识体系。哲学用它表示最高层次的“看”。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria mainly in learned and theological writing. The word stayed close to contemplation rather than to practical skill.
items.cn: 拉丁语主要在学术与神学写作中借用 theoria。这个词始终贴近“沉思”，而不是实用技能。

items.en: French théorie reached English in the 16c. with the sense of a scheme of ideas, especially in mathematics and philosophy.
items.cn: 法语 théorie 于 16 世纪进入英语，义为观念体系，尤用于数学与哲学。

items.en: The scientific revolution fixed the modern sense: a tested explanation of evidence. The everyday sense of a guess is older and never disappeared.
items.cn: 科学革命固定了现代义：对证据的受检验解释。日常“猜测”义更古老，并且从未消失。

note.en: The first group is theory's own family; the second ranks explanation words by how much evidence they claim.
note.cn: 第一组是 theory 自身的词族；第二组按“声称有多少证据”排列各种“解释”词。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas and principles rather than practice. It describes the mode, not the claim.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎观念与原理而非实践的。它描述方式，而不是主张。

entries.definition: a person who develops or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 建立或研究理论的人；理论家。

entries.definition: to form theories or speculate about something.
entries.definitionCN: 建立理论；对某事进行推测。

entries.definition: a statement proven from axioms, not a general explanation. It shares the Greek root but is a different kind of claim.
entries.definitionCN: 由公理证明的命题，不是一般性解释。它共享希腊词根，但主张的类型不同。

entries.definition: a proposed explanation to be tested. It is explicitly provisional, where theory may be either tested or loose.
entries.definitionCN: 有待检验的提议性解释。它明确是暂定的，而 theory 可能是已验证的，也可能松散。

entries.definition: a body of beliefs taught by a church, party, or school. It stresses authority rather than evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 教会、政党或学派所传授的信念体系。它强调权威，而非证据。

entries.definition: a basic rule or truth that explains how something works. It is usually narrower than a theory.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物如何运作的基本规则或真理。它通常比 theory 窄。

entries.definition: guessing about something without firm evidence. It matches the everyday and critical senses of theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在没有确凿证据的情况下猜测。它对应 theory 的日常义与批评义。

entries.definition: an opinion formed from incomplete information. It is formal and openly admits the lack of proof.
entries.definitionCN: 根据不完整信息形成的看法。它较正式，并公开承认缺乏证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek thea 'view' and theōros 'spectator' give theōria 'a looking at'. Family words theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize, theorem.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成 theōria“观看”。词族为 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。

normal.en: The theatre and theory share thea: both are about a view.
normal.cn: theatre 与 theory 共享 thea：两者都与“看”有关。

normal.en: A theorist is a spectator who writes down what the game explains.
normal.cn: 理论家就是一位把比赛所说明的东西写下来的观众。

normal.en: In theory is the view from the stand; in practice is the play on the field.
normal.cn: in theory 是看台上的视角；in practice 是球场上的踢法。

normal.en: A theorem is proved; a theory is supported. Different strength of claim.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的；theory 是被支持的。主张的强度不同。

normal.en: My theory about the vase is just watching turned into guessing.
normal.cn: 我对花瓶事件的 theory，只是把“看见”变成了“猜测”。

abstract.en: Theory is the distance we put between seeing and acting, in order to see better.
abstract.cn: 理论，是我们在“看见”与“行动”之间拉开的距离，为了看得更清楚。

abstract.en: A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory but a belief.
abstract.cn: 不可能出错的理论不是理论，而是信念。

abstract.en: Every practice is watched by some theory, even when the practitioner denies it.
abstract.cn: 每种实践都被某种理论注视着，即使实践者否认这一点。

examples.en: Darwin's theory took decades to be accepted by biologists.
examples.cn: 达尔文的理论花了几十年才被生物学家接受。

examples.en: The theory of harmony is easier to learn with a keyboard nearby.
examples.cn: 手边有键盘时，和声学理论更容易学。

examples.en: In theory the vaccine is free, but clinics still charge an admin fee.
examples.cn: 理论上疫苗是免费的，但诊所仍收取管理费。

dict_mnemonic.text: “思理论”——坐在看台上边看边思，慢慢就成了理论 → theory 理论、学说

root: 源自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成；核心是“先看，再解释”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of theory, all one act of watching: from the spectator's view grows a tested explanation, a doctrine, a set of principles, a guess, a classroom subject, or empty speculation.
sensesIntro.cn: theory 的八个义项都源自同一个“观看”动作：从观看者的视角生长出受检验的解释、学说、原理、猜测、课堂科目，或空洞的思辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spectators in a stand, watching a game and trying to explain it.
core.cn: 核心意象：看台上的观众，看着一场比赛并试图解释它。

branches.en: EXPLANATION: the same frame is a tested theory when the evidence is in, and a hypothesis when it is not.
branches.cn: 解释：同一框架在证据齐备时是受检验的理论，证据未到时是假设。

branches.en: DOCTRINE: a named school turns one explanation into a whole body of teaching.
branches.cn: 学说：一个有名字的学派把单一解释变成整套教导。

branches.en: PRINCIPLES: the rules behind a craft, whether written in a book or taught in a theory class.
branches.cn: 原理：一门技艺背后的规则，无论写在书里还是在理论课上讲授。

branches.en: SPECULATION: everyday guessing and idle theorizing are watching that never reaches the field.
branches.cn: 推测：日常猜测与空洞空论，都是从未落到球场上的观看。

branches.en: IN THEORY: the stand's viewpoint set explicitly against the field's practice.
branches.cn: 理论上：把看台的视角明确摆到球场的实践对面。

intro.en: Theory's family is built on the Greek root for viewing. English adds -etical, -ist, -ize, and -em, while theorem keeps a distinct mathematical path.
intro.cn: theory 的词族建立在希腊语“观看”词根上。英语加 -etical、-ist、-ize、-em；theorem 则走出一条不同的数学路径。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are theoria 'contemplation', theorema 'a thing looked at, a theorem', and the Late Latin adjective theoricus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 theoria“沉思”、theorema“被观看之物、定理”，以及晚期拉丁形容词 theoricus。

items.meaning: based on ideas and principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 基于观念与原理而非实践的（-etical 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper is purely theoretical and offers no data.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文纯属理论，没有提供数据。

items.meaningCN: 理论上；按原理（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Theoretically, the reaction should finish in an hour.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这个反应应在一小时内完成。

items.meaning: a person who develops or studies theories
items.example: Literary theorists disagree about the author's intention.
items.exampleCN: 文学理论家对作者意图的看法不一。

items.meaningCN: 建立理论；推测（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They theorized about the cause of the collapse.
items.exampleCN: 他们对坍塌的原因进行了理论推测。

items.meaningCN: 理论化；建立理论的过程（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The book mixes fieldwork with heavy theorization.
items.exampleCN: 这本书把田野调查与大量理论化混在一起。

items.meaningCN: 由公理证明的命题；定理
items.example: The theorem holds for every prime greater than two.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对每个大于二的素数都成立。

items.meaning: according to principle, not necessarily in fact
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按理说（未必符合事实）
items.example: In theory, the two systems can run together.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这两个系统可以同时运行。

items.meaning: the explanation of species change by natural selection
items.meaningCN: 进化论；以自然选择解释物种变化的理论
items.example: The theory of evolution rests on fossil and genetic evidence.
items.exampleCN: 进化论建立在化石与遗传学证据之上。

items.meaning: a lesson teaching principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 理论课；讲授原理而非实践的课程
items.example: Theory class meets on Monday; the lab is on Wednesday.
items.exampleCN: 理论课在周一，实验课在周三。

items.meaning: an explanation that claims a secret plot by powerful groups
items.meaningCN: 阴谋论；声称有权势集团秘密策划的解释
items.example: The rumour grew into a full conspiracy theory.
items.exampleCN: 这个传言发展成了完整的阴谋论。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun borrowed from Greek theōria

latinEntries.meaning: a thing looked at, a proposition, a theorem

latinEntries.structure: Late Latin adjective from Greek theōrikos

definition_zh: 在那里；往那里；在那里存在或发生（there be 句型）；用于引起注意或安慰
definition_en: in, at, or to that place, or used with be to say that something exists or happens
core_image: 手指向远处的一点：不是这里，是那一边
scene: 山顶的灯塔亮了，他抬手指向海湾对面。The lighthouse on the hill points to a small island over there.
sceneCN: 这里 there 是「在那里、往那边」（第 1 个义项：指远处的地方）；句意：山上的灯塔指向那边的一座小岛。

pos.zh: 在那里；往那里；在那一刻
（与 be 连用）表示存在；有

collocations.zh: 在外面；在广阔的世界上

derivatives.zh: 此后；以后（there 加 after 构成，指在那之后的时间）
在其中；在那一点上（there 加 in 构成的正式用语）
因此；所以（there 加 for 构成，表示由那推出的结果）
由此；从而（there 加 by 构成，表示借那件事）

senses.title: In or to that place
senses.definition: in, at, or to the place that has been mentioned or is being pointed at
senses.definitionCN: 在或到已被提到或正被指出的那个地方
senses.example: We drove to the beach and stayed there all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们开车去海边，在那里待了一下午。
senses.why: The word simply replaces the name of a distant place: instead of repeating where, you point with there.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只是代替远处地点的名字：不必重复地名，用 there 一指即可。

senses.title: Existence with be
senses.definition: used with be to say that something exists, happens, or is present
senses.definitionCN: 与 be 连用，表示某物存在、发生或在场
senses.example: There are two letters waiting for you on the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 桌上有两封等你拆的信。
senses.why: English puts the empty pointer there before the verb so that the new thing can arrive last, where it gets the stress.
senses.whyCN: 英语让空指的 there 站在动词前，好让新信息落在句末重音的位置上。

senses.title: At that point or moment
senses.definition: at that point in a process, argument, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 在某个进程、争论或局面的那一点上
senses.example: The talks stopped there and never moved forward again.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判停在那里，再没有向前推进。
senses.why: A process can be imagined as a road; there marks the spot on the road where things stand or stop.
senses.whyCN: 进程可以被想象成一条路；there 标出路上事情所处的或停下的那个点。

senses.title: Attention, comfort or greeting
senses.definition: used to attract attention, to comfort someone, or as an exclamation of triumph or sympathy
senses.definitionCN: 用于引起注意、安慰别人，或表示得意、同情的感叹
senses.example: There, there, the pain will be gone by morning.
senses.exampleCN: 好了，好了，到早上疼痛就会过去的。
senses.why: The pointing word turns toward a person: it calls attention, or pats the shoulder like a hand.
senses.whyCN: 指示词转向了人：它唤起注意，或像一只手一样拍拍肩膀。

intro.en: There is one of the oldest words in English, a native pointing adverb built on the same ancient demonstrative stem as the and that.
intro.cn: there 是英语最古老的词之一，是本土的指示副词，与 the、that 同出于一个古老的指示词干。

items.en: The reconstructed Germanic form is Thar, built on the demonstrative stem tha- that also gave the, that, they and this family of words.
items.cn: 重构的日耳曼语形式一般认为写作 Thar，建立在指示词干 tha- 之上；the、that、they 等词都出自这个词干。

items.en: Old English Ther meant in that place. It already served both as a place adverb and, with be, as an existence marker in some constructions.
items.cn: 古英语 Ther 意为「在那个地方」。它既作地点副词，也在一些句式里与 be 连用表示存在。

items.en: Scandinavian settlers used a closely related form, and in northern texts the Norse shape reinforced the English one.
items.cn: 斯堪的纳维亚移民使用一个十分相近的形式，在北部文献中，古诺斯语的形状加强了英语本词。

items.en: Middle English there spread the there be existence pattern widely, and a whole family of there compounds such as therein and thereby grew up.
items.cn: 中古英语 there 使 there be 存在句式广泛流行，therein、thereby 等一大批 there 复合词也在这一时期形成。

items.en: Modern English fixed the spelling there, and the empty-subject use in There is a book became one of the most common patterns in the language.
items.cn: 现代英语固定了拼写 there，而 There is a book 这类空主语句式成为英语中最常见的句型之一。

note.en: The first group collects the there- compounds that hide inside longer words; the second compares English words of pointing and place.
note.cn: 第一组是藏在长词内部的 there- 复合词家族；第二组比较英语中表示指示与地点的词。

entries.definition: possessive of they; sounds the same as there but owns things instead of locating them
entries.definitionCN: 他们的（they 的所有格）；与 there 同音，但表示所属而非地点

entries.definition: contraction of they are; a third same-sounding form often confused with there in writing
entries.definitionCN: they are 的缩写；第三个同音形式，书写中常与 there 混淆

entries.definition: by that means or as a result; there plus the preposition by
entries.definitionCN: 由此；从而（there 加介词 by 构成的复合词）

entries.definition: in or to this place, near the speaker; the near pole of the same pointing pair
entries.definitionCN: 在这里；往这里（靠近说话者一方），与 there 构成远近对立

entries.definition: over there, at a distance within sight; an old-fashioned pointing word
entries.definitionCN: 那边（目力所及的远处）；旧式的指示词

entries.definition: to that place; the old motion form of there, now literary
entries.definitionCN: 往那里；there 的古体运动方向形式，今仅见于书面

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the same old stem as the and that, the there be pattern, and the there- compound family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：与 the、that 同源的古词干、there be 存在句型、以及 there- 复合词家族。

normal.en: There here: here is near, there is far, one vowel apart.
normal.cn: here 与 there：here 近，there 远，一个元音之差。

normal.en: There is and there are put the real subject at the end of the sentence.
normal.cn: there is 和 there are 把真正的主语放在句末。

normal.en: Their, there, they're all sound the same: owning, pointing, contracting.
normal.cn: their、there、they're 同音：一个表所属，一个指示，一个是缩写。

normal.en: Therein, thereby, therefore all carry there inside a longer word.
normal.cn: therein、thereby、therefore 都把 there 藏在更长的词里。

normal.en: There, there is what you say while patting someone's shoulder.
normal.cn: there, there 是你拍着别人肩膀时说的话。

abstract.en: There is a finger stretched toward the far side of the map.
abstract.cn: there 是一根伸向地图远端的手指。

abstract.en: Every sentence needs an empty chair before the new guest walks in; there is that chair.
abstract.cn: 每句话都需要一把空椅子，好让新客人落座；there 就是那把椅子。

abstract.en: Here is where you stand; there is everything you can point to.
abstract.cn: here 是你站立之处；there 是你指向的一切。

examples.en: Put the keys there, on the shelf by the door.
examples.cn: 把钥匙放在那儿，门边的架子上。

examples.en: There is a small cafe at the end of this street.
examples.cn: 这条街的尽头有一家小咖啡馆。

examples.en: There, the work is finally done.
examples.cn: 好了，活儿终于干完了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「在这儿」倒过来——不在这儿，在「那儿」 → there 在那里

root: 英语本土指示副词：出自日耳曼语指示词干 tha-（与 the、that、they 同源），古英语 Ther「在那个地方」，与 here「这里」构成远近对立。无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: There starts as a plain pointing word, then stretches into the existence marker of there be, a point in a process, and finally a spoken pat on the shoulder.
sensesIntro.cn: there 从单纯的指示词出发，延伸为 there be 的存在标记、进程中的某一点，最后变成口语里安慰人的一声轻拍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing away from the speaker, to a far spot on the map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指离开说话者，指向远处地图上的一个点。

branches.en: The basic place pointing that replaces a repeated name of a place.
branches.cn: 基本的地点指示，代替重复出现的地名。

branches.en: The empty pointer that lets a new thing enter at the end of the sentence.
branches.cn: 空指的引导词，让新信息进入句末。

branches.en: The road image: a spot where a process stands still or moves on.
branches.cn: 道路意象：进程停留或前进的某个点。

branches.en: The word turns to a person, calling or comforting.
branches.cn: 词转向人，或唤起注意，或安慰对方。

branches.en: Both senses share one gesture: setting something at a spot, real or grammatical.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一个手势：把某物安放在某个位置上，无论实指还是语法上的。

intro.en: There has no suffix of its own, but it serves as the first half of a large family of formal compounds, there plus a small function word.
intro.cn: there 本身没有后缀，但它是庞大的正式复合词家族的前半部分：there 加一个小功能词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the family is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: there 没有拉丁语来源，词族属日耳曼本土，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.example: He was accused and convicted thereof.
The annex and everything thereto was signed.
items.exampleCN: 附件及其相关部分均已签署。
价格下降，从而帮助了出口商。

items.example: She left the company and thereafter worked freelance.
items.exampleCN: 她离开公司，此后做自由职业。

items.example: It rained; therefore the match was cancelled.
items.exampleCN: 下雨了，因此比赛取消了。

items.meaningCN: 在那附近；大约那个数目
在该条款之下（法律用语）
items.example: Rights granted thereunder must be exercised in writing.
items.exampleCN: 依该条款授予的权利须以书面形式行使。

items.meaning: used to say that something exists
items.example: There were many questions left unanswered.
items.exampleCN: 还有许多问题没有答案。

definition_zh: 因此；所以；故
definition_en: for that reason; used to introduce a conclusion drawn from what has just been said
core_image: 两段链条扣在一起，前一段的末端正好接上后一段的起点
scene: 报告的最后一页列出了全部数据，结论顺理成章地跟着出现。The pass was closed by snow; therefore the convoy took the longer road.
sceneCN: 这里 therefore 是「因此、所以」（第 1 个义项：表示由前文推出的结论）；句意给出由数据推出结论的典型场景。

pos.zh: 因此；所以；故（连接性副词，引出由前文推出的结论）

derivatives.zh: 借此；由此（同构复合词，fore 换成 by）
为此（法律用语，与 therefore 的构词成分相同）
其中（同构复合词）
附于该处（法律用语）
其；由此（法律用语）
为何；原因（where + fore 的同构形式）

senses.title: For that reason
senses.definition: used to introduce a result that the previous statement provides the reason for
senses.definitionCN: 引出结果，而前面的陈述给出这一结果的理由
senses.example: The road was closed; therefore we took the longer route.
senses.exampleCN: 道路封闭了，因此我们走了更远的那条路。
senses.why: Therefore is there plus fore, for that: the word points back at the stated cause and presents what follows as owed to it.
senses.whyCN: therefore 是 there 加 fore「为此」：它回指已说出的原因，并把后文呈现为由那个原因所欠下的。

senses.title: The inevitable step in an argument
senses.titleCN: 论证中必然推出的结论
senses.definition: used in logic where the conclusion cannot be false if the premises are true
senses.definitionCN: 用于逻辑，当前提为真时结论不可能为假
senses.example: All men are mortal; Socrates is a man; therefore Socrates is mortal.
senses.exampleCN: 人皆有死；苏格拉底是人；因此苏格拉底有死。
senses.why: In a syllogism the word marks the forced last line, the point at which the premises hand over their conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 在三段论里，这个词标出被迫写下的最后一行，也就是前提交出结论的那一点。

senses.title: The conclusion of a proof
senses.definition: used in mathematics to introduce a result derived from earlier steps
senses.definitionCN: 数学中用于引出由前面步骤得到的结果
senses.example: The two triangles are congruent; therefore their angles are equal.
senses.exampleCN: 两个三角形全等，因此它们的角相等。
senses.why: Proof writing needs a visible hinge between the derivation and the result, and this is that hinge.
senses.whyCN: 证明写作需要在推导与结果之间有一个看得见的铰链，这个词就是那个铰链。

senses.title: The formal hence of legal prose
senses.definition: used in formal and legal writing to state a required consequence
senses.definitionCN: 在正式与法律文字中陈述必须产生的后果
senses.example: The defendant failed to appear; therefore the court proceeded.
senses.exampleCN: 被告未出庭，故法庭继续审理。
senses.why: Statutes chain a condition to a consequence, and the older register of the word suits that chain of obligation.
senses.whyCN: 法条把条件与后果串起来，而这个词较古的语体正适合这条义务链。

senses.title: For that purpose, in older English
senses.definition: archaic: for that purpose or to that end
senses.definitionCN: 古旧义：为了那个目的、朝向那个目标
senses.example: He laboured therefore that the work might be finished.
senses.exampleCN: 他为此辛勤劳作，好把那件工作完成。
senses.why: Fore once meant for or on account of, so the compound could carry purpose as well as cause; modern English keeps mainly the causal sense.
senses.whyCN: fore 旧有「为了、由于」之义，因此这个复合词既能表目的也能表原因；现代英语主要保留因果义。

senses.title: The close of a rebuttal
senses.definition: used to close an argument after the evidence has been weighed
senses.definitionCN: 在证据权衡完毕后用来收束论证
senses.example: The evidence is incomplete; therefore the claim cannot stand.
senses.exampleCN: 证据不完整，因此这一主张不能成立。
senses.why: Debate ends by naming what the audience must accept, and the word converts a review of evidence into a verdict.
senses.whyCN: 辩论以点明听众必须接受什么来收尾，这个词把对证据的回顾转成裁决。

senses.title: The inference in an experiment
senses.definition: used in reports to state what the data allow the authors to infer
senses.definitionCN: 在报告中陈述数据让作者能推出什么
senses.example: The readings were consistent; therefore the model was accepted.
senses.exampleCN: 读数一致，因此该模型被接受。
senses.why: Scientific style separates observation from inference, and the word marks the crossing point.
senses.whyCN: 科学文体把观察与推论分开，这个词标出跨越的那一点。

senses.title: The summing up in teaching
senses.definition: used in explanation to gather the previous points into one conclusion
senses.definitionCN: 在讲解中把前面的要点收拢成一个结论
senses.example: Therefore, the plan needs revision before the next stage.
senses.exampleCN: 因此，这项计划在进入下一阶段之前需要修订。
senses.why: Teaching needs a marker that says the scattered facts now add up, which is the conversational use of the same hinge.
senses.whyCN: 教学需要一个标记说「零散的事实到此合成一个结论」，这是同一个铰链的口语用法。

intro.en: Therefore is an English compound of there and fore, an old word for before or for that. It is Germanic, not Latin, and the Latin ergo is a counterpart rather than a source. The direct source is clear; the first date is approximate.
intro.cn: therefore 是英语复合词，由 there 与 fore 构成，fore 是表示「在前、为此」的古词。它属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，拉丁语 ergo 只是对应词而非来源。直接来源清楚，首见年代为约数。

items.en: There comes from Old English thær, the locative form meaning in that place, later extended to that point in speech.
items.cn: there 来自古英语 thær，本为「在那个地方」的处所形式，后来扩展到言语中的「那一点」。

items.en: Fore meant before or in front, and in phrases it could mean for that or on account of that.
items.cn: fore 意为在前，在短语中也可表「为了那个、由于那个」。

items.en: The two parts join as therfore in the Middle English period, keeping the pointing function of there.
items.cn: 两部分在中古英语时期合为 therfore，保留了 there 的回指功能。

items.en: Sixteenth-century prose fixes therefore as the standard marker of a conclusion, beside the older thus and hence.
items.cn: 十六世纪的印本散文把 therefore 固定为结论标记，与较早的 thus、hence 并列。

items.en: Modern English keeps therefore for logical consequence and therefor, a different spelling, for legal purpose.
items.cn: 现代英语用 therefore 表逻辑后果，而用拼写不同的 therefor 表法律上的目的。

note.en: The first group shares the there plus fore pattern and includes the look-alike therefor. The second group names conclusions and reasons, and includes consequently and subsequently, which differ in whether causation is claimed.
note.cn: 第一组共享 there + fore 的构词模式，并包含形近的 therefor。第二组表示结论与理由，其中 consequently 与 subsequently 的区别在于是否主张因果。

entries.definition: For that purpose, a legal spelling with one r fewer than therefore; it is not a misspelling of the adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 为此目的，法律用语，比 therefore 少一个 r；它不是 therefore 的拼写错误。

entries.definition: By that means, with by in place of fore.
entries.definitionCN: 借此、由此，用 by 代替 fore。

entries.definition: Of that or of it, in legal and formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 其、由此，用于法律与正式文字。

entries.definition: In that place or in that document.
entries.definitionCN: 在其中、在该文件之内。

entries.definition: For what reason, built on where instead of there, and preserved in legal and poetic prose.
entries.definitionCN: 为何、由于什么，用 where 而非 there 构成，存于法律与诗歌文字中。

entries.definition: In this way or as a result, often marking a conclusion in formal prose.
entries.definitionCN: 如此、因此，正式文字中常作结论标记。

entries.definition: From this fact, as a consequence; also from this time.
entries.definitionCN: 由此、因此；也表「从此时起」。

entries.definition: As a result; stronger on causation and weaker on argument than therefore.
entries.definitionCN: 结果上；比 therefore 更强调因果，论证色彩较弱。

entries.definition: In a way that matches what has just been said, often of action taken.
entries.definitionCN: 按照刚说的情况而行事。

entries.definition: Afterwards in time only; it never supplies the causal link that therefore carries.
entries.definitionCN: 只表时间上的随后；它从不提供 therefore 所带的因果连接。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real there plus fore pattern and keep therefore apart from subsequently and consequently.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 there + fore 构词模式，并把 therefore 与 subsequently、consequently 区分开。

normal.en: There points back, fore means for: therefore is for that, pointing at the reason just given.
normal.cn: there 回指，fore 意为「为了」：therefore 就是「为此」，指向刚给出的理由。

normal.en: In a syllogism the word is the last line, the place where premises hand over their conclusion.
normal.cn: 在三段论里，这个词是最后一行，是前提交出结论的地方。

normal.en: Mathematicians write therefore where the proof turns from work to result.
normal.cn: 数学家在证明从推导转向结果的地方写 therefore。

normal.en: Then there is time, therefore is cause: one is a clock, the other a hinge.
normal.cn: then 是时间，therefore 是原因：一个是钟，一个是铰链。

normal.en: Lawyers keep therefor with one r for purpose, and therefore with two for conclusions.
normal.cn: 律师用少一个 r 的 therefor 表目的，用两个 r 的 therefore 表结论。

abstract.en: A conclusion is a debt the earlier sentence has already agreed to pay.
abstract.cn: 结论是前一句话已经答应偿付的一笔债。

abstract.en: Saying therefore is claiming that nothing else could have followed.
abstract.cn: 说「因此」，就是在主张不可能有别的结果。

abstract.en: The word works because two sentences can be made to touch.
abstract.cn: 这个词能起作用，只因为两句话可以被接得贴在一起。

examples.en: The sample was contaminated; therefore the results were discarded.
examples.cn: 样品被污染，因此结果作废。

examples.en: The two accounts disagree; therefore at least one is wrong.
examples.cn: 两种说法互相矛盾，因此至少有一种是错的。

examples.en: The bridge carries no traffic; therefore repairs can wait.
examples.cn: 这座桥不通车，因此修缮可以推迟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「戴尔福」，there 指「那件事」，fore 指「为了」：为了那件事，所以如此

root: 英语复合词 there + fore（fore 古义为「在前、为了」）。属日耳曼语来源，拉丁语 ergo「因此」只是对应词而非词源，故不列拉丁同族。现代英语用 therefore 表逻辑后果，用拼写 therefor 表法律上的目的。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one hinge: something has been stated, and what follows is presented as owed to it. The setting changes from daily reasoning to syllogism, proof, statute, archaic purpose, rebuttal, experiment and classroom summary.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个铰链：某事已被陈述，后文被呈现为由它欠下的。场景从日常推理换到三段论、证明、法条、古旧的目的义、辩驳、实验与课堂总结。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chains joined so that the end of one meets the beginning of the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条链条相接，前一条的末端正好扣住后一条的起点。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY CAUSE: a result the previous sentence has already paid for.
branches.cn: 日常原因：前一语句已经付过账的结果。

branches.en: THE FORCED LINE: the last step of a syllogism, and the closing line of a proof.
branches.cn: 被迫的一行：三段论的最后一步，以及证明的收束句。

branches.en: THE STATUTE: a condition in law handing over a required consequence.
branches.cn: 法条：法律中的条件交出必须承担的后果。

branches.en: THE OLD PURPOSE: for that end, a sense modern English has mostly dropped.
branches.cn: 古旧目的义：为了那个目标，现代英语已大体舍弃。

branches.en: THE VERDICT: closing a rebuttal, crossing from data to inference, and summing up a lesson.
branches.cn: 裁决：收束辩驳、从数据跨到推论，以及总结一堂课。

intro.en: Therefore is not a suffixed word but a compound of there and fore. English reuses the same frame in thereby, therein, thereof and the legal therefor, and wherefore swaps where for there.
intro.cn: therefore 不是加后缀的词，而是 there 与 fore 的复合词。英语用同一框架造出 thereby、therein、thereof 与法律用语的 therefor，wherefore 则把 where 换到 there 的位置。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed. Latin ergo and igitur are counterparts in meaning only.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条。拉丁语 ergo 与 igitur 只是在意义上对应。

items.meaning: in that place; at that point
items.meaningCN: 在那个地方；在那一点上
items.example: The first half of the compound is the pointing finger.
items.exampleCN: 复合词的前半截就是那根指过去的手指。

items.example: The second half supplies the sense of on account of.
items.exampleCN: 后半截提供「由于、为了」的意思。

items.example: The compound is fixed by the sixteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词在十六世纪固定下来。

items.example: Legal drafters keep the shorter spelling for purpose.
items.exampleCN: 法律起草者用较短的拼写表目的。

items.example: The frame swaps fore for by and keeps the pointing.
items.exampleCN: 这个框架把 fore 换成 by，回指功能不变。

items.example: The same slot also takes a preposition of place.
items.exampleCN: 同一个位置也可以放表示处所的前置词。

items.example: Contracts use the form to point back at a defined item.
items.exampleCN: 合同用它回指已定义的事项。

items.example: The interrogative version of the same frame survives in legal prose.
items.exampleCN: 同一框架的疑问版本存活于法律文字中。

items.example: It is the older rival that therefore largely displaced.
items.exampleCN: 它是 therefore 大体上取代了的较早对手。

items.example: It marks manner as well as conclusion, which therefore does not.
items.exampleCN: 它既标方式也标结论，而 therefore 不标方式。

definition_zh: 他们；她们；它们；泛指的人（如 everyone...they）
definition_en: the people, animals, or things already mentioned, or people in general when the exact person is unknown
core_image: 一群人站在远处，你指向他们：不是你，不是我，是他们
scene: 孩子们在操场上踢球，喊声传到教室。They are still playing football after the last bell.
sceneCN: 这里 they 是「他们」（第 1 个义项：指前文提到的一群人）；句意：放学铃响后他们还在踢球。

pos.zh: 泛指某人；那个人们（单数用法）

derivatives.zh: 他们（宾格；与 they 同属一个代词词形变化表）
他们的（所有格；与 there、they're 同音，注意区分）
他们的（东西）（名词性物主代词，可独立使用）
他们自己（反身代词，由 them 加 selves 构成）

senses.title: The people already mentioned
senses.titleCN: 他们；她们：指前文说过的那些人
senses.definition: the group of people, animals, or things that has just been spoken or written about, as subject of the verb
senses.definitionCN: 刚被提到的人群、动物或事物，在句中作主语
senses.example: The students finished the exam, and they went out to celebrate.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们考完试，就出去庆祝了。
senses.why: A sentence already names its people once; they steps in so the names need not be repeated.
senses.whyCN: 一句话只需把人名点一次；they 替补上场，省得反复报名字。

senses.title: Things or animals
senses.definition: used for animals or things in the plural, or for a single animal whose sex is unknown
senses.definitionCN: 用于复数的动物或事物，或性别不明的单个动物
senses.example: The books arrived late, but they were all undamaged.
senses.exampleCN: 书到得晚了，但全都完好无损。
senses.why: The old plural pointing word covers every third-person plural that is not us or you, without asking about species.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的复数指示词包揽一切既非我们也非你们的第三人称复数，不问物种。

senses.title: People in general
senses.definition: people in general, or an unspecified person, especially after words like everyone, somebody, or nobody
senses.definitionCN: 泛指一般人，或身份不明的某个人，尤其跟在 everyone、somebody、nobody 之后
senses.example: If anybody calls, tell them I am in a meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 如果有人打电话，告诉那人我在开会。
senses.why: When the exact person is unknown or unimportant, English borrows the plural form because it carries no marking of gender.
senses.whyCN: 当具体是谁不重要时，英语借用复数形式，因为它不带任何性别标记。

senses.title: A single person of unspecified gender
senses.definition: one person whose gender is not stated or is not relevant, as in a doctor...they
senses.definitionCN: 性别未说明或无关紧要的某一个人，如 a doctor...they
senses.example: A good teacher listens before they speak.
senses.exampleCN: 好老师先倾听再开口。
senses.why: Written English since the Middle Ages has allowed they for one unknown person; modern usage has revived and extended this old right.
senses.whyCN: 自中古英语起，书面语就允许用 they 指身份不明者；现代用法复兴并扩展了这一古老权利。

intro.en: They is a Norse loan. Old English had hie for they, but the Scandinavian settlers' word their, from the same ancient stem as that, pushed it out almost everywhere.
intro.cn: they 是古诺斯语借词。古英语本来用 hie 表示「他们」，但斯堪的纳维亚移民带来的、与 that 同源的 their 一词几乎把它挤出了所有方言。

items.en: Old Norse Their meant they, built on the demonstrative stem tha- that also produced the and that.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 Their 意为「他们」，建立在指示词干 tha- 之上；the、that 也出自同一词干。

items.en: Old English used hie, with forms like heora for their and him for them; the system was starting to blur by sound change.
items.cn: 古英语用 hie 表「他们」，所有格是 heora，与格是 him；语音演变已让这套代词开始混淆。

items.en: In the Danelaw, Norse settlers spoke a close cousin of English; their pronouns were easier to tell apart and were adopted in the north first.
items.cn: 在丹麦法区，诺斯移民说的语言与英语是近亲；他们的代词更易分辨，于是在北部最先被采用。

items.en: Middle English spread they, their and them from north to south, replacing most of the old hie forms by the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，they、their、them 由北向南推广，到十五世纪基本取代了旧的 hie 系列形式。

items.en: Standard English settled the paradigm they, them, their, theirs, and later added the singular use now written about as singular they.
items.cn: 标准英语固定了 they、them、their、theirs 的范式，后来又发展出如今被称为 singular they 的单数用法。

note.en: The first group lines up the same-sounding pronoun pair; the second collects the other personal pronouns of English.
note.cn: 第一组是同音易混的代词；第二组是英语其他人称代词。

entries.definition: belonging to them; same sound as they and there, different job
entries.definitionCN: 他们的（所属格）；与 they、there 同音而职能不同

entries.definition: in that place; a pointing adverb that sounds the same as their and they're
entries.definitionCN: 在那里；与 their、they're 同音的地点副词

entries.definition: the old singular object form of thou; spelled almost like they
entries.definitionCN: 古语「你」的宾格（thou 的宾格），拼写与 they 相近

entries.definition: the speaker and others; the pronoun on the near side of the conversation
entries.definitionCN: 我们；谈话中靠近说话者一方的人称代词

entries.definition: the person or people spoken to; singular and plural in one form
entries.definitionCN: 你；你们（单复数同形）

entries.definition: persons in general; a full noun that can replace they in formal writing
entries.definitionCN: 人们；正式文体中可替代泛指 they 的名词

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the Norse origin, the full paradigm they them their theirs, and the sound-alike trio.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：古诺斯语来源、they them their theirs 完整范式、以及同音三兄弟。

normal.en: They came from the Vikings: Old Norse their replaced the old English hie.
normal.cn: they 来自北欧海盗：古诺斯语 their 取代了古英语的 hie。

normal.en: The paradigm: they do, them see, their book, theirs is red, themselves.
normal.cn: 范式：they 作主语，them 作宾语，their 表所属，theirs 独立用，themselves 反身。

normal.en: They, their, there, they're: four spellings, three sounds, endless exam questions.
normal.cn: they、their、there、they're：四种拼法，三个读音，考题无穷。

normal.en: They say is how English quotes the crowd without naming it.
normal.cn: they say 是英语引用「大家说」而不点名的方式。

normal.en: Everybody...they: the singular they has been legal in English for six centuries.
normal.cn: everybody 后接 they：单数 they 在英语里合法了六个世纪。

abstract.en: They is the crowd seen from a distance, one shape for every mixture.
abstract.cn: they 是远远望见的人群，无论怎样混合都只用一个形状。

abstract.en: A pronoun is a loan of attention: you lend your name once, and they carries it.
abstract.cn: 代词是注意力的借贷：名字只需出借一次，they 替你背着它走。

abstract.en: When we do not know who, English shrugs and says they.
abstract.cn: 当不知道是谁时，英语耸耸肩说 they。

examples.en: They built the bridge in two years.
examples.cn: 他们用两年建成了那座桥。

examples.en: My keys were on the table, but they are gone now.
examples.cn: 我的钥匙原在桌上，但现在不见了。

examples.en: Everyone should bring their own lunch, and they should label it.
examples.cn: 每个人都该自带午餐，并写上名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞」——一群人喊「瑞」打招呼，他们来了 → they 他们

root: 古诺斯语 Their「他们」（指示词干 tha- 的复数）→ 经丹麦法区进入中古英语，取代古英语 hie；与 the、that 同源，属日耳曼指示词系统。

sensesIntro.en: They first replaces a named group, then covers plural animals and things, and finally serves for people in general and for one person whose gender does not matter.
sensesIntro.cn: they 先替代已点名的人群，再涵盖复数的动物与事物，最后服务泛指的人们与性别不明的单个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a group standing at a distance, pointed at with one short word.
core.cn: 核心意象：站在远处的人群，用一个短词指过去。

branches.en: The core job: subject pronoun for a known group.
branches.cn: 核心职能：为已知人群作主语代词。

branches.en: The plural reaches animals and things without asking.
branches.cn: 复数用法覆盖动物与事物，不问种类。

branches.en: Generic they quotes the crowd: they say.
branches.cn: 泛指 they 引述人群：they say。

branches.en: Singular they fills the gap left by he and she.
branches.cn: 单数 they 填补 he 与 she 留下的空位。

branches.en: Both extensions come from the same neutrality: no gender, no species, no fuss.
branches.cn: 两项扩展出于同一中立性：不分性别、不分物种、毫无芥蒂。

intro.en: They has no derivational family in the usual sense; its paradigm of forms and its there- sound-alikes are the real system to master.
intro.cn: they 没有常规意义上的派生词族；真正要掌握的是它的词形范式与 there- 同音词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; they is Norse-Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: they 没有拉丁语来源，属诺斯-日耳曼系统，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.meaning: the people or things already mentioned

items.example: I met them at the station.

items.meaningCN: 他们的（东西）（名词性所有格）

items.meaning: they, back on their own selves

items.meaningCN: 这些（this 的复数，同属 tha- 词干家族）

definition_zh: 厚的；粗的；浓的；浓密的；愚蠢的；雾重的
definition_en: having a large distance between two sides, densely packed, not flowing easily, or slow to understand
core_image: 两大平面之间塞满了东西：一掌压不下去的厚
scene: 大雪整夜未停，清晨推开院门，积雪没了脚踝。The snow lay thick on the garden path.
sceneCN: 这里 thick 是「厚厚地积着、浓密」（第 3 个义项：密集铺满）；句意：花园小径上积雪很厚。

derivatives.zh: 厚厚地；浓密地（thick 加副词后缀 -ly）
厚度；浓度；层（thick 加名词后缀 -ness）
使变厚；变浓（thick 加动词后缀 -en）
增稠剂（thicken 加施动者后缀 -er）

senses.title: Large between two surfaces
senses.definition: having a large distance between two opposite sides or surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 两个相对的面之间距离较大
senses.example: She wore a thick coat against the winter wind.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿上厚外套抵御寒风。
senses.why: The basic measure: a slab is thick when its two faces stand far apart, so the word names size across rather than along.
senses.whyCN: 最基本的量度：一块板的两面离得远就叫厚，这个词量的是横向的尺寸而不是纵向的。

senses.title: Densely packed together
senses.definition: growing or standing close together in large numbers
senses.definitionCN: 大量生长或聚集在一起，间距很小
senses.example: The forest is thick with pines and moss.
senses.exampleCN: 森林里松树和苔藓长得很密。
senses.why: When many things fill a space so closely that light struggles through, the crowding itself feels like thickness.
senses.whyCN: 当许多东西挤满一个空间、连光都难以穿过时，这种拥挤本身就让人感觉「厚」。

senses.title: Not flowing easily
senses.definition: (of a liquid) not flowing easily because it is dense or heavy
senses.definitionCN: 指液体浓稠、不易流动
senses.example: The sauce boiled down until it was thick and glossy.
senses.exampleCN: 酱汁熬到浓稠发亮。
senses.why: A dense liquid resists movement the way a thick plank resists bending, so the same word covers both blocks and broths.
senses.whyCN: 浓稠的液体抗拒流动，就像厚板抗拒弯折，同一个词便同时盖住了板块与汤汁。

senses.title: Slow to understand
senses.definition: (informal) not quick to understand, a little stupid
senses.definitionCN: （口语）理解得慢，有点迟钝
senses.example: Don't be thick, the answer is staring at you.
senses.exampleCN: 别犯迷糊了，答案就明摆在你眼前。
senses.why: An idea slides off a head as light slides off fog; the dense mind, like dense air, lets little through.
senses.whyCN: 想法滑不过一个脑袋，正如光穿不透浓雾；迟钝的头脑与浓重的空气一样，透不进多少东西。

senses.title: Heavy and hard to see through
senses.definition: (of fog, smoke, or air) heavy and difficult to see or breathe through
senses.definitionCN: 指雾、烟或空气浓重，难以看透或呼吸
senses.example: Thick smoke rolled down the stairwell.
senses.exampleCN: 浓烟涌下楼梯间。
senses.why: Smoke and fog fill space the way timber fills a wall, so seeing through them becomes as hard as drilling through a board.
senses.whyCN: 烟雾像木头填满墙壁一样填满空间，看穿它便变得像钻穿木板一样困难。

intro.en: Thick is a native Germanic word, old at the root: it goes back to an ancient word for densely pressed or crowded, and its cousins are found across the Germanic languages.
intro.cn: thick 是日耳曼本土词，词根十分古老：它追溯到表示「挤压密集」的古代词形，同源词遍布各日耳曼语言。

items.en: The common Germanic root is Theku, generally reconstructed as meaning thick, pressed close, or crowded; it had no Latin relatives.
items.cn: 公认的日耳曼词根一般重构为 Theku，意为「厚的、挤压紧密的、拥挤的」；它没有拉丁语同源词。

items.en: Old English Thicce already carried the main senses: solid in size, crowded in number, and heavy in texture.
items.cn: 古英语 Thicce 已具备主要义项：体积厚实、数量密集、质地浓重。

items.en: Norse Pokkr, a close cousin, reinforced the northern forms of the adjective.
items.cn: 古诺斯语的近亲词 Pokkr 加强了这一形容词在北方的形式。

items.en: Middle English thikke spread the figurative uses, and the adverb thikke(or thick) without -ly entered common speech.
items.cn: 中古英语 thikke 发展出比喻用法，无 -ly 的副词形式也进入日常口语。

items.en: Modern English fixed thick, thickly and thickness, and the idioms through thick and thin and thick as thieves gave the word a social flavour.
items.cn: 现代英语固定了 thick、thickly 与 thickness，习语 through thick and thin 和 thick as thieves 又给这个词添了人情味。

note.en: The first group holds the thick word family; the second compares adjectives of density and slowness.
note.cn: 第一组是 thick 词族；第二组比较表示密度与迟钝的形容词。

entries.definition: to make or become thicker
entries.definitionCN: 使变厚；变浓（thick 的动词形式）

entries.definition: the measure of how thick something is
entries.definitionCN: 厚度；浓度（thick 的名词形式）

entries.definition: a clever act meant to deceive; only one letter from thick, no relation in meaning
entries.definitionCN: 诡计；与 thick 仅一字母之差，词义无关

entries.definition: packed closely together; formal partner of the crowded sense of thick
entries.definitionCN: 稠密的；thick 密集义的正式对应词

entries.definition: of great weight or force; overlaps with thick smoke and thick weather
entries.definitionCN: 沉重的；在浓烟、恶劣天气等用法上与 thick 交叠

entries.definition: not quick to understand; politer than the informal sense of thick
entries.definitionCN: 迟缓的；比 thick 的迟钝义更委婉

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the Germanic root of pressed-together, the thick family, and two famous idioms.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：日耳曼「挤压密集」词根、thick 词族、以及两大著名习语。

normal.en: One image covers all senses: so much stuff that nothing moves easily.
normal.cn: 一个意象贯穿各义：东西多到什么都动弹不得。

normal.en: Thick fog, thick soup, thick forest: all hard to see through or push through.
normal.cn: 浓雾、浓汤、密林：都难以看穿或穿过。

normal.en: Through thick and thin once meant through forest and open ground.
normal.cn: through thick and thin 原指穿过密林与空地。

normal.en: Thick as thieves: as close and crowded together as partners in crime.
normal.cn: thick as thieves：像同伙一样亲密无间。

normal.en: Thicken the soup: the -en suffix turns the adjective into a verb.
normal.cn: thicken the soup：后缀 -en 把形容词变成动词。

abstract.en: Thick is the world pressing in from two sides at once.
abstract.cn: thick 是世界从两面同时挤进来的感觉。

abstract.en: A thick mind is a wall; a thick book is a door.
abstract.cn: 迟钝的头脑是墙，厚厚的书是门。

abstract.en: Where thin divides, thick protects.
abstract.cn: thin 分隔，thick 庇护。

examples.en: The walls are nearly a metre thick.
examples.cn: 这墙几乎有一米厚。

examples.en: A thick fog covered the harbour all morning.
examples.cn: 浓雾整个上午笼罩着海港。

examples.en: Her accent was thick with the sounds of her hometown.
examples.cn: 她的口音带着浓重的乡音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希克」——厚得只透一丝缝隙 → thick 厚的；浓的

root: 日耳曼本土词：原始日耳曼语词根（一般认为重构为 Theku，意为挤压密集）→ 古英语 Thicce「厚的、密的、浓的」，与德语 dick、荷兰语 dik 同源；无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Thick measures size across a slab, then spreads to crowding, to dense liquids and smoke, and finally, with a smile, to a slow head.
sensesIntro.cn: thick 先量板子的厚度，再延伸到拥挤、浓稠的液体与烟雾，最后带笑指向迟钝的脑袋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two faces pressed far apart, so full that nothing slips through.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个面被撑得很开，塞得满满，什么也穿不过。

branches.en: The physical measure of a slab or a wall.
branches.cn: 板与墙的物理厚度。

branches.en: Crowding that fills space like solid matter.
branches.cn: 像固体一样填满空间的拥挤。

branches.en: Liquids too dense to run freely.
branches.cn: 浓稠难流的液体。

branches.en: Fog that blocks the eye, a head that blocks the idea.
branches.cn: 挡住视线的雾，挡住想法的头脑。

branches.en: Both rest on one resistance: the world refusing to yield.
branches.cn: 两者立于同一种抗拒：世界拒绝让步。

intro.en: Thick is a bare Germanic root; English keeps it productive with small native suffixes like -en, -ness and -ly.
intro.cn: thick 是光秃秃的日耳曼词根；英语用 -en、-ness、-ly 等本土小后缀让它保持能产。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source exists; the family below is native or Norse, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；下表词族为本土或北欧来源，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: Stir in flour to thicken the stew.

items.meaning: the quality or measure of being thick
items.example: The ice reached a thickness of half a metre.
A rabbit vanished into the thicket.
items.exampleCN: 兔子钻进灌木丛不见了。

items.example: A thickset guard stood at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 一名矮壮的卫兵站在门口。

items.example: You need to be thick-skinned in politics.

items.meaningCN: 德语「厚的」，与 thick 同根
items.example: German dick means thick, not the English noun.
items.exampleCN: 德语 dick 意为厚，与英语名词无关。

items.meaning: through good and bad times alike
items.meaningCN: 同甘共苦；无论顺境逆境
items.example: They stayed friends through thick and thin.
items.exampleCN: 他们同甘共苦，友谊未变。

definition_zh: 薄的；细的；瘦的；稀疏的；稀薄的；（动词）使变薄；变稀
definition_en: having a small distance between two sides, little flesh, or few things in a space; to make or become thinner
core_image: 两指间只剩一张纸的缝隙：几乎没有厚度
scene: 减肥半年后,她的旧戒指又合手了。After half a year of dieting, her wrists grew thin and the old ring fit again.
sceneCN: 这里 thin 是「变瘦」（第 3 个义项：身上脂肪减少）；句意：节食半年后她的手腕变细，旧戒指又能戴上了。

derivatives.zh: 薄薄地；稀疏地（thin 加副词后缀 -ly）
薄；细；瘦；稀（thin 加名词后缀 -ness）
稀释剂（比较级转名词，指油漆稀释液）
稀疏下来（短语动词，指密度降低）

senses.title: Small distance between surfaces
senses.definition: having a small distance between two opposite sides or surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 两个相对面之间的距离很小
senses.example: She cut the bread into thin slices.
senses.exampleCN: 她把面包切成薄片。
senses.why: The direct opposite of thick: where thick fills the gap, thin almost erases it.
senses.whyCN: thick 的直接反义：thick 填满间隙，thin 几乎把间隙抹掉。

senses.title: Sparse or scattered
senses.definition: with few things or people in a space; not dense
senses.definitionCN: 空间中的人或物很少；不稠密
senses.example: The crowd was thin after midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 午夜后人群稀稀落落。
senses.why: What is true of a slice is true of a group: take parts away, and what remains spreads thin.
senses.whyCN: 对薄片成立的道理对人群同样成立：抽走一部分，剩下的就摊薄了。

senses.title: Having little flesh
senses.definition: (of a person or animal) having little fat or flesh on the body
senses.definitionCN: 指人或动物身上脂肪或肉少
senses.example: He looked thin after weeks of illness.
senses.exampleCN: 病了几周后他看上去瘦了。
senses.why: The body itself is read as a slab: fat gives it thickness, and losing fat makes the body thin.
senses.whyCN: 身体本身被当作一块板来读：脂肪给身体厚度，减去脂肪身体就 thin 了。

senses.title: Weak or not convincing
senses.definition: lacking force, substance, or believability, as an excuse or evidence
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏力度、内容或可信度，如借口或证据
senses.example: The committee dismissed his excuse as thin.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会认为他的借口站不住脚。
senses.why: An argument with little substance is a slice with little substance: almost nothing between its two faces.
senses.whyCN: 内容贫乏的论证如同内容贫乏的薄片：两面之间几乎什么都没有。

senses.title: To become or make thinner
senses.definition: to make or become thinner, less dense, or less crowded
senses.definitionCN: 使变薄、变稀或变疏，或自身变得如此
senses.example: The fog thinned as the sun climbed.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳升高后雾渐渐变薄。
senses.why: The adjective turns into a verb without any new ending: English lets qualities move on their own.
senses.whyCN: 形容词不加任何新词尾直接变成动词：英语允许性质自己走动。

intro.en: Thin is a native Germanic word, twin of thick in daily life and nearly twin in history: both descend from one ancient root family of density words.
intro.cn: thin 是日耳曼本土词，在日常生活中与 thick 成对，历史上也几乎是孪生：两者都出自同一古老的密度词族。

items.en: The common Germanic root Thinn, generally reconstructed as meaning stretched or drawn thin, spread across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 公认日耳曼词根一般重构为 Thinn，意为「拉伸变细」，遍布各日耳曼语言。

items.en: Old English Tinne (or thinne) served for flat things, slender bodies, and sparse crowds alike.
items.cn: 古英语 Tinne (or thinne) 兼指扁平物、细瘦身形与稀疏人群。

items.en: Norse Thunn(or thynn)r reinforced the northern forms, as with its partner thick.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 Thunn(or thynnr) 与它的搭档 thick 一样加强了北方形式。

items.en: Middle English thinne settled the spelling, and the verb use without endings grew common in craft talk.
items.cn: 中古英语 thinne 固定拼写，无词尾的动词用法在手工艺语中渐趋常用。

items.en: Modern English doubled the n before -er, -est and -ing (thinner, thinned, thinning) and spread the word into science and slang alike.
items.cn: 现代英语在 -er、-est、-ing 前双写 n（thinner、thinned、thinning），并把这个词推广到科学与俚语。

note.en: The first group is the thin family; the second compares words of slenderness and weakness.
note.cn: 第一组是 thin 词族；第二组比较表示纤细与贫弱的词。

entries.definition: in a thin way; the adverb of thin
entries.definitionCN: 薄薄地；稀疏地（thin 的副词）

entries.definition: the comparative of thin, and also a liquid that dilutes paint
entries.definitionCN: 更瘦/更薄；也是稀释油漆的稀释剂

entries.definition: an object; only one letter from thin, unrelated in meaning
entries.definitionCN: 东西；与 thin 仅一字母之差，词义无关

entries.definition: attractively thin and graceful
entries.definitionCN: 苗条修长的；带优雅意味的 thin

entries.definition: very thin in an unattractive or joking way
entries.definitionCN: 皮包骨的；口语化、略含贬义的 thin

entries.definition: thinly scattered; the formal partner of the sparse sense
entries.definitionCN: 稀疏的；thin 稀疏义的正式对应词

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the thick-thin pair, the doubled n in thinning, and the verb without an ending.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：thick-thin 成对、thinning 的双写 n、以及不加词尾的动词用法。

normal.en: Thick and thin are twins: one fills, one empties.
normal.cn: thick 与 thin 是孪生：一个填满，一个抽空。

normal.en: Thin, thinner, thinnest: double the n when a vowel follows.
normal.cn: thin, thinner, thinnest：后接元音时双写 n。

normal.en: On thin ice: standing where the layer is too weak to hold you.
normal.cn: on thin ice：站在薄得撑不住你的冰面上。

normal.en: Vanish into thin air: become as insubstantial as the fog.
normal.cn: vanish into thin air：变得像雾一样无影无踪。

normal.en: The fog thinned: the adjective works as a verb with no new ending.
normal.cn: 雾变薄了：形容词不加词尾直接当动词用。

abstract.en: Thin is the world after something has been taken away.
abstract.cn: thin 是被拿走某物之后的世界。

abstract.en: A thin excuse has nothing between its two faces.
abstract.cn: 站不住脚的借口，两面之间空无一物。

abstract.en: Where thick protects, thin exposes.
abstract.cn: thick 庇护之处，thin 无所遮拦。

examples.en: The ice on the lake is still too thin to walk on.
examples.cn: 湖面的冰还太薄，不能上人。

examples.en: She stirred the paint with a little thinner.
examples.cn: 她往颜料里加了点稀释剂搅拌。

examples.en: His voice sounded thin over the bad phone line.
examples.cn: 电话线路不好，他的声音听上去单薄。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希恩」——瘦得让人希罕又心疼 → thin 瘦的；薄的

root: 日耳曼本土词：词根一般重构为 Thinn「拉伸变细」→ 古英语 Tinne (or thinne)；与德语 dunn、荷兰语 dun 同源，与 thick 同属本土密度词族。

sensesIntro.en: Thin starts as the small measure of a slice, spreads to sparse crowds and lean bodies, then to weak arguments, and finally works as its own verb.
sensesIntro.cn: thin 从薄片的厚度出发，延伸到稀疏的人群与清瘦的身形、单薄的论证，最后亲自动词化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: almost nothing between two faces, the gap nearly gone.
core.cn: 核心意象：两面之间几乎没有东西，间隙近乎消失。

branches.en: The small physical measure.
branches.cn: 小的物理量度。

branches.en: Few things spread over a space.
branches.cn: 稀疏地摊在一个空间里。

branches.en: The body read as a slab without its fat layer.
branches.cn: 被读作失去脂肪层的身体。

branches.en: Arguments and evidence that cannot carry weight.
branches.cn: 承受不了重量的论证与证据。

branches.en: The word acts on the world instead of describing it.
branches.cn: 这个词开始改造世界，而不只是描述世界。

intro.en: Thin takes small native endings and doubles its n when they begin with a vowel; the verb needs no ending at all.
intro.cn: thin 加本土小词尾，且当词尾以元音开头时双写 n；动词化则完全不需要词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the family is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；词族为日耳曼本土，拉丁词条留空。

items.meaning: more thin; also a paint-diluting liquid

items.example: The thinnest wire carries the signal.
The thinning of the ozone layer alarmed scientists.
items.exampleCN: 臭氧层变薄令科学家担忧。

items.meaning: in a thin or weak way
items.example: He smiled thinly at the joke.
items.exampleCN: 听到这个笑话他勉强笑了笑。

items.example: The thinness of the walls surprised them.

items.meaningCN: 脱脂的（fat 词族的对照）

items.example: A skinny cat waited by the bin.
items.exampleCN: 一只瘦猫在垃圾桶旁等着。

definition_zh: 东西；事物；事情；事件；情况（复数）
definition_en: an object that is not named, an event or situation, or matters in general
core_image: 一个装着说不清之物的口袋：指哪算哪
scene: 搬家那天,纸箱堆满了走廊。The first thing to pack was the bookshelf.
sceneCN: 这里 thing 是「东西、物件」（第 1 个义项：泛指物品）；句意：头一件要打包的东西是书架。

derivatives.zh: 某事；某物（some 加 thing 构成的复合代词）
任何事物（any 加 thing 构成的复合代词）
一切事物（every 加 thing 构成的复合代词）
没有什么（复合代词，与 -thing 家族平行）

senses.title: An object without a name
senses.definition: an object whose name is not known, not stated, or not worth stating
senses.definitionCN: 名称未知、不必说或不愿说的物品
senses.example: What is that thing on the shelf?
senses.exampleCN: 架子上那个东西是什么？
senses.why: When a name is missing, the word opens an empty box and points: whatever fits inside becomes the thing.
senses.whyCN: 名字缺席时，这个词打开一只空盒一指：装得进去的都算这个 thing。

senses.title: An event or matter
senses.definition: an event, an action, or a matter to be dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 发生的事、要做的事或待处理的事项
senses.example: There is one more thing to discuss before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭前还有一件事要讨论。
senses.why: The empty box works for happenings too: an unnamed event slides in as easily as an unnamed object.
senses.whyCN: 空盒同样装得下发生的事：没点名的事件和没点名的物件一样容易滑进去。

senses.title: Situations in general
senses.definition: the general state of affairs, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 事情的总体状况，通常用复数
senses.example: Things have changed a lot since last year.
senses.exampleCN: 自去年以来情况变化很大。
senses.why: Piled together, single matters become the whole situation; the plural turns many boxes into one landscape.
senses.whyCN: 许多单件事堆在一起便成了整个局面；复数把许多盒子合成一幅风景。

senses.title: Personal possessions
senses.definition: the objects that belong to someone, especially clothes and personal items
senses.definitionCN: 属于某人的物品，尤指衣物与个人用品
senses.example: Gather your things and leave quietly.
senses.exampleCN: 收拾好你的东西，安静地离开。
senses.why: A person's life scatters into objects; the plural thing gathers the scattered self back into a bag.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的生活散落为物品；复数的 things 把散落的自己收进一只袋子。

senses.title: A creature, said with feeling
senses.definition: a living being, spoken of with affection, pity, or annoyance instead of a name
senses.definitionCN: 以怜爱、怜悯或嗔怪的口吻称呼的生灵
senses.example: You poor thing, come inside and warm up.
senses.exampleCN: 你这可怜的小东西，进来暖和暖和。
senses.why: When feeling replaces the name, even a person can be packed into the empty box, softly or sharply.
senses.whyCN: 当情感替代名字，连人也能被装进那只空盒——或温柔，或带刺。

intro.en: Thing is one of the oldest words in English, and its ancient Germanic ancestor meant not an object but an assembly: the meeting where matters were decided.
intro.cn: thing 是英语最古老的词之一；它的日耳曼远祖本义不是「物」而是「集会」——裁决事务的会议。

items.en: The reconstructed Germanic root Thingam meant a set time or an assembly for deciding matters; the Icelandic parliament is still the Althing.
items.cn: 重构的日耳曼词根一般认为意为「约定的时刻或裁决事务的集会」；冰岛议会至今仍叫 Althing。

items.en: Old English Thing meant a meeting, a matter under discussion, and by extension an affair or an object concerned with it.
items.cn: 古英语 Thing 意为集会、议事之事项，进而指相关的事务或物件。

items.en: Norse Thing, meaning assembly, reinforced the English word in the north, where place names like Thingwall keep the meeting sense.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 Thing（集会）在北方加强了英语本词；Thingwall 之类的地名保留了「会议」义。

items.en: Middle English thing widened into the great all-purpose noun: any object, any event, any matter.
items.cn: 中古英语 thing 扩展为万能名词：任何物件、任何事件、任何事项。

items.en: Modern English multiplied the compounds something, anything, everything, nothing, making thing the backbone of English indefinites.
items.cn: 现代英语衍生出 something、anything、everything、nothing，使 thing 成为英语不定代词的骨架。

note.en: The first group holds the -thing compounds; the second compares the general nouns of object and matter.
note.cn: 第一组是 -thing 复合代词；第二组比较指物与指事的泛称名词。

entries.definition: an unspecified object or matter
entries.definitionCN: 某物；某事（some 加 thing）

entries.definition: not anything; the empty end of the -thing family
entries.definitionCN: 什么也没有（-thing 家族的空端）

entries.definition: of small thickness; one letter from thing, no relation in meaning
entries.definitionCN: 薄的；与 thing 仅一字母之差，词义无关

entries.definition: a material thing that can be seen and touched
entries.definitionCN: 物体；可见可触的具体物件

entries.definition: a subject or situation to deal with; more formal than thing
entries.definitionCN: 事项；比 thing 更正式的事务用词

entries.definition: things in a mass; the casual spoken partner
entries.definitionCN: 东西；口语中随意的对应词

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the ancient assembly sense, the -thing compounds, and the plural of situations.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：古老的集会义、-thing 复合词、以及表情况的复数用法。

normal.en: Thing once meant a meeting; Iceland's parliament, the Althing, keeps the old sense.
normal.cn: thing 曾指集会；冰岛议会 Althing 保留着古义。

normal.en: Something, anything, everything, nothing: four compounds, one backbone.
normal.cn: something、anything、everything、nothing：四个复合词，同一根骨架。

normal.en: Things have changed: the plural speaks of the whole situation.
normal.cn: things have changed：复数谈论整个局面。

normal.en: Pack your things: possessions gather under the same word.
normal.cn: pack your things：随身物品也归同一个词。

normal.en: You poor thing: feeling replaces the name.
normal.cn: you poor thing：情感替代了名字。

abstract.en: Thing is the box language opens when the name is missing.
abstract.cn: thing 是名字缺席时语言打开的盒子。

abstract.en: Every meeting of people is a meeting of things to decide.
abstract.cn: 人的集会，就是待决之事项的集会。

abstract.en: A life can be packed into things; a day can be packed into things to do.
abstract.cn: 生活可以装进物品，一天可以装进待办之事。

examples.en: The important thing is to arrive on time.
examples.cn: 重要的是准时到达。

examples.en: Things are getting better between them.
examples.cn: 他们之间的关系正在好转。

examples.en: She packed her things and moved out.
examples.cn: 她收拾好东西搬了出去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯英」——说不清是啥的东西,一声「斯英?」了之 → thing 东西

root: 日耳曼本土词：词根一般指「集会、议事事项」（冰岛议会 Althing 存古）→ 古英语 Thing「会议；事务；物件」，经古诺斯语强化；无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Thing is the all-purpose box: it holds unnamed objects, unnamed events, the whole situation, a person's belongings, and even a person spoken of with feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: thing 是万能的盒子：装得下没点名的物件与事件、整个局面、一个人的随身物品，甚至一个被带着情感称呼的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty box that points instead of naming.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只不称呼而只指示的空盒。

branches.en: The object whose name is withheld or unknown.
branches.cn: 名字未知或省略的物件。

branches.en: The event or matter waiting to be handled.
branches.cn: 等待处理的事件或事项。

branches.en: The plural that sums up a whole situation.
branches.cn: 概括整个局面的复数。

branches.en: Belongings gathered, and persons named by feeling.
branches.cn: 被收拢的物品，被情感指称的人。

branches.en: Object and event share one box: the old assembly decided matters, not mere objects.
branches.cn: 物与事共用一盒：古老的集会裁决的是事项，而非单纯的物件。

intro.en: Thing builds compounds with pronoun words, forming the backbone of English indefinite pronouns.
intro.cn: thing 与代词性成分构成复合词，撑起英语不定代词的骨架。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the compounds are native formations, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；复合词均为本土构造，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: There is something in my shoe.

items.meaning: any object or matter at all

items.example: The trip was anything but relaxing.
I will not go; for one thing, it is too far.
The thing is, we have no time.
All things considered, the plan is sound.
items.exampleCN: 通盘考虑，这个计划是稳妥的。

definition_zh: 想；思考；认为；回想；打算
definition_en: to use the mind to form ideas, opinions, or plans, or to hold something as an opinion
core_image: 头脑里的工作台：想法在上面被拿起、翻看、装配
scene: 窗外下着雨,她盯着棋盘很久。Think before you move the knight.
sceneCN: 这里 think 是「思考」（第 1 个义项：用心智形成想法）；句意：走马之前先想一想。

pos.zh: 思考；想法（口语，如 have a think）

derivatives.zh: 想法；思想；思考（think 的过去式转名词）
思考；见解（think 的现在分词转名词）
思考者；思想家（think 加施动者后缀 -er）
深思的；体贴的（thought 加形容词后缀 -ful）

senses.title: To use the mind
senses.definition: to use the mind to form ideas, solve problems, or make decisions
senses.definitionCN: 运用头脑形成想法、解决问题或作出决定
senses.example: Give me a minute to think.
senses.exampleCN: 给我一分钟想一想。
senses.why: The core act: the mind works visibly hard, and the word simply names that work.
senses.whyCN: 核心行为：头脑明显地在劳作，这个词就是给这份劳作起名。

senses.title: To hold an opinion
senses.definition: to believe or hold something as an opinion, often less certain than know
senses.definitionCN: 相信或把某事当作看法，确定性低于 know
senses.example: I think the meeting starts at nine.
senses.exampleCN: 我想会议九点开始。
senses.why: An idea formed in the head is offered to the world as a claim; think marks the claim as personal and revisable.
senses.whyCN: 在头脑中形成的想法被作为主张交给世界；think 标记这主张属个人且可修正。

senses.title: To recall or imagine
senses.definition: to bring a past thing to mind, or to form a picture of something not present
senses.definitionCN: 让往事浮现心头，或构想不在眼前之物
senses.example: She still thinks of that summer by the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 她仍会想起海边那个夏天。
senses.why: The mind's workbench holds not only the present but the past and the possible; both arrive by the same act.
senses.whyCN: 头脑的工作台不只放当下，也放过去与可能；两者经由同一个动作到来。

senses.title: To intend or plan
senses.definition: to have a plan or intention in the mind, often in thinking of doing
senses.definitionCN: 心中存有计划或意图，常用于 thinking of doing
senses.example: We are thinking of moving to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在考虑搬到海边住。
senses.why: A plan is an action rehearsed in the head before it happens; thinking is that rehearsal.
senses.whyCN: 计划是行动在头脑中的预演；thinking 就是这场预演。

senses.title: To expect or suppose
senses.definition: to expect or suppose that something will happen or is true
senses.definitionCN: 预期某事会发生或属实
senses.example: I think it will clear up by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 我料想到中午天会放晴。
senses.why: Opinion pointed forward becomes expectation: the same claim, wearing tomorrow's clothes.
senses.whyCN: 看法指向未来便成了预期：同一个主张，换上了明天的衣裳。

intro.en: Think is a native Germanic verb, and its strange past form thought preserves a very old sound pattern in which a t replaced the k of the present.
intro.cn: think 是日耳曼本土动词；其奇特的过去式 thought 保留了一种极古老的音变模式：过去式以 t 代替现在的 k。

items.en: The common Germanic root Thankjan meant to seem or to appear to the mind; the same root gave both think and seem in some relatives.
items.cn: 公认日耳曼词根 Thankjan 意为「在心中显现、似乎」；同一词根在部分亲属语言中既给出 think 也给出 seem 义。

items.en: Old English had two verbs: Thencan, to think in the modern sense, and Thyncan, to seem. Their past forms crossed and merged.
items.cn: 古英语有两个动词：Thencan（现代的「想」）与 Thyncan（「似乎」）；二者的过去式相互交叉并合流。

items.en: Middle English merged the two verbs into think with past thought, and the seeming sense faded away.
items.cn: 中古英语将两词合并为 think，过去式 thought，「似乎」义渐消。

items.en: Modern English fixed the paradigm think, thought and built a wide family: thinker, thoughtful, thoughtless, overthink.
items.cn: 现代英语固定 think-thought 范式，并衍生出 thinker、thoughtful、thoughtless、overthink 等庞大家族。

items.en: The noun think (have a think) and think tank show the verb moving into noun jobs in modern colloquial and institutional English.
items.cn: 名词 think（have a think）与 think tank 显示该动词在现代口语与机构用语中转任名词。

note.en: The first group is the think-thought family; the second compares verbs of mind work.
note.cn: 第一组是 think-thought 词族；第二组比较各种「心智劳作」动词。

entries.definition: past of think, and also the noun for an idea
entries.definitionCN: think 的过去式，也可作名词指想法

entries.definition: an object; shares most sounds with think but is a different word entirely
entries.definitionCN: 东西；与 think 读音相近，但完全是另一个词

entries.definition: to express gratitude; from a related Germanic root about inner feeling
entries.definitionCN: 感谢；出自关于内心感受的相关日耳曼词根

entries.definition: to accept something as true; stronger commitment than think
entries.definitionCN: 相信；比 think 承诺更强

entries.definition: to think about carefully before deciding
entries.definitionCN: 斟酌；决定前的仔细思考

entries.definition: to assume something is true without proof
entries.definitionCN: 假定；设想（无充分证据的认定）

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the old t-past pattern, the think-thought family, and the difference between think and know.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：古老的 t 形过去式、think-thought 词族、以及 think 与 know 之别。

normal.en: Think, thought, thought: the k becomes ght in the past, an ancient fingerprint.
normal.cn: think 的过去式 thought：k 变 ght，是古老的指纹。

normal.en: I think softens a claim; I know hardens it.
normal.cn: I think 让主张变软，I know 让主张变硬。

normal.en: Think of recalls, think about studies, think over weighs.
normal.cn: think of 是想起，think about 是研究，think over 是掂量。

normal.en: A think tank is a tank full of thinking, not of fuel.
normal.cn: think tank 是装满思考的罐子，不是装燃料的。

normal.en: Thoughtful people think of others as well as of problems.
normal.cn: thoughtful 的人既想问题，也想别人。

abstract.en: Thinking is the rehearsal room where actions try their lines.
abstract.cn: 思考是排练厅，行动在里面练习台词。

abstract.en: Every thought is a small claim asking to be tested.
abstract.cn: 每个想法都是一桩等待检验的小主张。

abstract.en: The mind's workbench never quite empties.
abstract.cn: 头脑的工作台从不清空。

examples.en: She sat quietly, thinking about the offer.
examples.cn: 她静静坐着，考虑那份邀约。

examples.en: I thought the train left at noon, but it was three.
examples.cn: 我以为火车中午开，其实是三点。

examples.en: He thought carefully before answering.
examples.cn: 他仔细想过才回答。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯因克」——思考像沉进 sink（水槽）里打转 → think 思考

root: 日耳曼本土动词：词根 Thankjan「在心中显现」→ 古英语 Thencan「想」与 Thyncan「似乎」合流；过去式 thought 保留古音变（k→t 型）；同根亲族含 thank。

sensesIntro.en: Think works the mind in five directions: solving, opining, recalling, planning, and expecting, all from one image of ideas handled on an inner workbench.
sensesIntro.cn: think 让心智朝五个方向运作：解题、持论、追忆、筹划、预期——全部来自「内在工作台上摆弄想法」这一个意象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an inner workbench where ideas are picked up, turned over, and assembled.
core.cn: 核心意象：内在工作台，想法在上面被拿起、翻看、装配。

branches.en: The bare labour of the mind.
branches.cn: 心智的朴素劳作。

branches.en: A claim offered as personal and revisable.
branches.cn: 作为个人可修正意见提出的主张。

branches.en: The workbench reaching into past and possibility.
branches.cn: 伸向过去与可能的工作台。

branches.en: Actions rehearsed before they happen.
branches.cn: 行动发生前的预演。

branches.en: Opinion dressed for tomorrow.
branches.cn: 换上明天衣裳的看法。

intro.en: Think builds its family with small native endings and compounds, mostly through its past form thought.
intro.cn: think 用本土小词尾与复合词构建词族，大多经由其过去式 thought。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the family is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；词族为日耳曼本土，拉丁词条留空。

items.meaning: past of think; also a noun for an idea
items.meaningCN: think 的过去式；名词「想法」
items.example: She thought it over; a thought struck her.
items.exampleCN: 她考虑了一下；忽然有了个想法。

items.meaning: the activity or opinions of thinking
items.example: His thinking changed after the course.

items.meaningCN: 欠考虑的；不顾及他人的
items.exampleCN: 一句欠考虑的话伤了她。
别把那个回复想太多了。

items.meaning: a research organization full of ideas
items.example: The think tank published a housing report.
items.exampleCN: 该智库发布了住房报告。

items.meaningCN: 感谢（同根亲族，源于内心感受）

definition_zh: 这；这个；这样的事；此刻；这么
definition_en: used to point at a person or thing near in place, time, or thought
core_image: 伸手可及处的那一个：近处的手指
scene: 他把车钥匙递到你掌心,金属还带着温度。Hold this while I lock the door.
sceneCN: 这里 this 是「这个」（第 1 个义项：指近处的物）；句意：我锁门时你拿一下这个。

derivatives.zh: 这些（this 的复数形式）
那；那个（this 的远指对应词）
如此；因而（同族指示副词，正式用语）
从那里（同族 there 系列正式词）

senses.title: The near one
senses.titleCN: 这；这个：指近处的人或物
senses.definition: used to point at a person or thing that is near in place or just being held or shown
senses.definitionCN: 指向空间上近处或正被拿着、展示的人或物
senses.example: This book is the one I told you about.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书就是我跟你说的那本。
senses.why: Every pointing pair needs a near pole; this is the finger curled toward the speaker's own side.
senses.whyCN: 每对指示词都需要近端；this 就是朝说话者一侧弯回的那根手指。

senses.title: The present time
senses.definition: used with time words to mean the current day, week, or moment
senses.definitionCN: 与时间词连用，表示今天、本周或此刻
senses.example: This week has gone far too fast.
senses.exampleCN: 这一周过得太快了。
senses.why: Time is mapped onto space: the moment you stand in is near, so the near pointer marks it.
senses.whyCN: 时间被映射到空间上：你立足的时刻是「近」的，近指词便落在它身上。

senses.title: Introducing something new
senses.titleCN: 引出新话题：以下要说的
senses.definition: used to refer to something about to be said or introduced in a story
senses.definitionCN: 指即将说出或故事中即将登场的事物
senses.example: Now this is the interesting part of the recipe.
senses.exampleCN: 现在来看这个食谱最有趣的部分。
senses.why: Before the audience can see the thing, the speaker plants the pointer in the empty spot ahead.
senses.whyCN: 在观众看清事物之前，说话者先把手指插进前方空位。

senses.title: To this degree
senses.definition: to the degree or amount shown, as in this big or this far
senses.definitionCN: 达到所指的程度或数量，如 this big、this far
senses.example: I didn't know the lake was this deep.
senses.exampleCN: 我不知道这湖有这么深。
senses.why: The pointing hand can measure: the distance between two palms becomes the size of the word.
senses.whyCN: 指示的手也能量度：两只手掌之间的距离变成了词的大小。

intro.en: This is a native English demonstrative built on the ancient stem tha- that also gave the, that, they and there; it has pointed at near things for as long as English has existed.
intro.cn: this 是本土英语指示词，建立在古老词干 tha- 之上；the、that、they、there 都出自这个词干。英语存在多久，它就指了多久的近物。

items.en: The Germanic demonstrative stem Tha- produced the whole pointing system: articles, pronouns and place words.
items.cn: 日耳曼指示词干 Tha- 产出整套指示系统：冠词、代词与地点词。

items.en: Old English This (or This) served for all genders of the near demonstrative, alongside the (feminine) and that (neuter).
items.cn: 古英语 This (or This) 作近指代词用于各个性别，与 the（阴性）、that（中性）并行。

items.en: Norse Thessi (or Thessi) kept a similar near form, and contact reinforced the English system.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 Thessi (or Thessi) 保有相近的近指形式，语言接触加固了英语体系。

items.en: Middle English paired this with that as the neat near-far duo, and these took over the plural.
items.cn: 中古英语把 this 与 that 配成整洁的近远对，these 接管了复数。

items.en: Modern English extended this to time, to story introductions, and to degree, making it one of the most frequent words in the language.
items.cn: 现代英语把 this 扩展到时间、故事引入与程度，使之成为英语最高频词之一。

note.en: The first group holds the pointing system this belongs to; the second gathers its near partners in grammar.
note.cn: 第一组是 this 所属的指示系统；第二组是语法中的近指伙伴。

entries.definition: the plural of this, for several near things
entries.definitionCN: 这些（this 的复数，指近处的多个）

entries.definition: the far-side partner of the near pointer
entries.definitionCN: 那；那个（远指，与近指相对）

entries.definition: in this way; the adverb cousin in the pointing family
entries.definitionCN: 如此；因而（指示词族的副词近亲）

entries.definition: in this place; the adverb built on the same near idea
entries.definitionCN: 在这里；同一近指观念的地点副词

entries.definition: the definite article, the worn-down member of the same family
entries.definitionCN: 定冠词；同一家族磨蚀最重的成员

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the tha- stem family, the near-far pair, and this as measure word.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：tha- 词干家族、近远对立、以及 this 的量度用法。

normal.en: This is near, that is far: one vowel length apart.
normal.cn: this 近，that 远：一个元音长度之差。

normal.en: This morning, this week: time near you takes the near pointer.
normal.cn: this morning、this week：靠近你的时间用近指词。

normal.en: These books are this heavy: plural shape, degree job.
normal.cn: these books are this heavy：复数形与程度义各司其职。

normal.en: The, this, that, they, there: one ancient stem runs them all.
normal.cn: the、this、that、they、there：同一古老词干统领。

normal.en: This deep: the hand measures and the word reports.
normal.cn: this deep：手在量，词在报数。

abstract.en: This is the speaker's side of the world made into a word.
abstract.cn: this 是把世界的「说话者一侧」做成的词。

abstract.en: Nearness is a place before it is a time.
abstract.cn: 「近」先是地点，然后才是时间。

abstract.en: Every conversation begins by planting this in the shared ground.
abstract.cn: 每场对话都从把 this 插进共同地面开始。

examples.en: This is my favourite chair.
examples.cn: 这是我最喜欢的椅子。

examples.en: I have lived here all this time.
examples.cn: 我一直住在这里，始终如此。

examples.en: It isn't this cold every winter.
examples.cn: 并不是每个冬天都这么冷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞斯」——东西就在手边,一伸手就「瑞斯（于是）」拿到了 → this 这个

root: 本土指示词：日耳曼词干 Tha-（与 the、that、they、there 同源）→ 古英语 This (or This)「近指」→ 中古英语与 that 配成近远对；复数 these；程度义后起。

sensesIntro.en: This points at the near object, claims the present moment, introduces what comes next, and finally measures how much.
sensesIntro.cn: this 先指近处的物，再占有当下时刻，引入即将登场者，最后丈量程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger curled back toward the speaker's own side.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝说话者一侧弯回的手指。

branches.en: The near pole of the pointing pair.
branches.cn: 指示对的近端。

branches.en: The moment the speaker stands in.
branches.cn: 说话者立足的时刻。

branches.en: The pointer set before the thing arrives.
branches.cn: 事物登场前插下的指示牌。

branches.en: The hand stretched into a ruler.
branches.cn: 伸开成标尺的手。

branches.en: Both rest on nearness: of hand or of moment.
branches.cn: 两者都立于「近」：手之近或时之近。

intro.en: This belongs to the tha- demonstrative family, the most productive native system in English grammar.
intro.cn: this 属于 tha- 指示词家族，这是英语语法中能产性最强的本土体系。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the family is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
